audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side read "Skill" while content win[6] and the packet levelChart both read Aurelion Sol, and the why under it described Xerath winning the stage.
audit.why: With two items and heavy Stardust his Breath of Light is sustained DPS and Singularity's centre executes on percent health, while Xerath has no dash. Rows 0-5 are Xerath's on pure range (750/1000/1050 vs his 750 channel).
audit.corrected: phases[6].side set to Aurelion Sol with the why rewritten to match; win[6] already reads Aurelion Sol so no content edit is needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes and the phase whys described a generic Xerath curve and never named the Stardust clock, which is the only spike that matters here.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's passive permanently improves his abilities with Stardust, so every denied minion delays his flip; Xerath's spikes are Lost Chapter and level 6.
audit.corrected: Spike prose now names Lost Chapter, the level-6 pre-mobility snipe, and the two-item Stardust flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four applicable interactions were absent: Shocking Orb and Rite of the Arcane cancel his Breath of Light and Astral Flight channels; Falling Star cancels YOUR channel; Singularity is percent-health with an execute so resistances are the wrong answer; Astral Flight cuts your retreat over terrain and you have no dash. breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit.
audit.why: Kit flags: his Q and W are channel, his E is percentHealth + execute + zone, his R is hardCC, his W is terrain. Xerath's R is channel (any CC cancels).
audit.corrected: Channel cancels added to breakdown.mid and dosFull[1].d; the execute and percent-health point added to breakdown.late; the terrain retreat-cut added to dontsFull[2].d; breakdown.cooldowns now carries Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, Singularity 12s, Breath of Light 3s and Shocking Orb 13s.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text called the stun "Falling Star (E)" — Falling Star is his R; E is Singularity.
audit.why: Riot slot assignment per the kit file.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both bodies replaced with content matching their titles.

audit.why: matchup-lint reported MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE / HEDGING on these fields; cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits.
audit.corrected: Pronouns matched to the enemy champion; bled trade text replaced with field-specific advice; cooldown lines given real per-rank numbers.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Aurelion Sol

edits.before: Late Xerath wins fights from the next postal code: stun the entry, barrage the objective, and never be seen.
edits.after: Late his stacked Breath of Light melts you and Singularity ignores MR — Astral Flight picks the angle from 1500.

edits.before: E completes the kill kit: the stun into full rotation is real damage even now. Hold it for HIS aggression, not yours.
edits.after: E completes the kit and cancels channels: Shocking Orb ends Breath of Light outright. Hold it for his step-up, not your poke.

edits.before: Rite of the Arcane online — chipped targets anywhere in the lane's zip code are now finishable. Shove and snipe.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane online and he still has no dash until Astral Flight — chipped, he is finishable from 5000. Shove and snipe.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks third-bars. He farms at half HP forever or he doesn't farm.
edits.after: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks third-bars. Every wave he farms low is Stardust he does not bank.

edits.before: You out-range the range class — every spell he lands cost him three steps into your artillery to cast.
edits.after: You out-range the range class — Breath of Light needs 750 and seconds of standing still to earn its damage.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol wins by landing Astral Flight, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Aurelion Sol wins by surviving to full Stardust — then Breath of Light out-DPSes you and Falling Star cancels your channel.

edits.before: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane.
edits.after: Q the last-hit from 750, W the sidestep, and walk — Breath of Light must be held on you for seconds and your slow ends it early.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: Spending E on chip, then having no cancel when he channels Breath of Light into you — Shocking Orb is your one interrupt every 13 seconds.

edits.before: Ahead, extend the artillery line: chip Aurelion Sol off every CS, R his recalls, and rotate barrages to rivers — a fed Xerath taxes the whole map from fog.
edits.after: Ahead, extend the artillery line: chip Aurelion Sol off every CS so his Stardust stalls, R his recalls, and rotate barrages to river — his scaling is a clock you own.

edits.before: - Xerath vs Aurelion Sol - Track: Aurelion Sol Astral Flight. - Hold E for his engage — the stun is your entire defense. - Fights start when Astral Flight ends. - The R is for endings, not openings.
edits.after: - Xerath vs Aurelion Sol - Track: Astral Flight, 22s at rank 1. - Hold E to cancel his Breath of Light channel. - Fights start when Astral Flight ends. - The R is for endings, not openings.

edits.before: Open the chip ledger immediately: Q every last-hit, W every dodge, and bank Manaflow — Xerath lanes are won at minute three, collected at minute twenty.
edits.after: Open the chip ledger immediately: Q every last-hit, W his step-up to breathe, and bank Manaflow — every minion you deny costs him Stardust he never gets back.

edits.before: Post-6 you shove-and-snipe: crash the wave, R the chipped, and rotate your barrage to every river contest — your poke decides objectives you never attend.
edits.after: Post-6 you shove and snipe, but Falling Star cancels Rite of the Arcane — channel only once his R is spent. Your E cancels his Q and W channels outright.

edits.before: Lost Chapter makes the artillery infinite; level 6 finishes what poke starts; Luden's turns chip into third-bars.
edits.after: Lost Chapter makes the artillery infinite; level 6 snipes him before he has mobility; two items of Stardust flips it.

edits.before: If Aurelion Sol opens the score, reset expectations and respect Astral Flight doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with max-range Qs and stay relevant through R snipes.
edits.after: One kill and his Stardust snowballs — deny stacks, farm at 750, and never sit low near Singularity's execute. After a second, max-range Qs only and stay relevant through R snipes.

edits.before: Carry from the next postal code — no champion converts vision and distance into damage like Xerath; your job is never being where the fight thinks you are.
edits.after: Carry from 5000 units: Aurelion Sol needs 750 to breathe on you and Astral Flight to reach it, so hold the gap and his Stardust never converts.

edits.before: You are off-screen and decisive: stun the engage, barrage the pit, and re-position before the minimap finds you. Distance is your defense and your damage.
edits.after: Off-screen and decisive, but never low near Singularity — its centre executes and resistances do not stop percent health. Stun his entry, barrage the pit from 5000.

edits.before: His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: His only reposition and escape: 22s at rank 1, and while it is down he is a stationary battery stuck at 750 range.

edits.before: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane.
edits.after: Breath of Light is a channel he has to hold on you — Eye of Destruction's slow drags him off the beam and Comet lands free.

edits.before: That is Aurelion Sol’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Inside 750 his breath ticks up damage every second you stay.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: Astral Flight crosses 1500 units of terrain and cuts your walk home — you have no dash, so hold Flash for the wall, not for the damage.

edits.before: Your Rite of the Arcane (R) lets you snipe him while he has no mobility to dodge, and Falling Star (E) stun is slow enough to walk out of. Keep chunking him and deny stacks so his Singularity power spike arrives late.
edits.after: Your Rite of the Arcane (R) snipes him while he has no mobility to dodge, and his Falling Star (R) stun is slow enough to walk out of. Keep chunking him and deny Stardust so his Singularity (E) spike arrives late.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Shocking Orb has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 and 16s maxed — while it is down he is a stationary 750-range battery and your Q-W lands for free. - Your 13s Shocking Orb has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The 130s R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
